experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Adventure
experiences.description: Experience the iconic Magic Kingdom with classic rides like Space Mountain, Pirates of the Caribbean, and the Haunted Mansion. Watch the spectacular Festival of Fantasy parade and end the night with the breathtaking Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle. Perfect for families with children of all ages.
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase & Food Exploration
experiences.description: Stroll through EPCOT's World Showcase featuring 11 country pavilions where you can sample authentic international cuisines, watch cultural performances, and explore unique merchandise. Try dishes from Mexico, Japan, France, and more. Also enjoy thrilling rides like Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure.
experiences.location: EPCOT, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney's Hollywood Studios Star Wars Experience
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in the galaxy far, far away at Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Pilot the Millennium Falcon on Smugglers Run, survive the intense Rise of the Resistance ride, and build your own custom lightsaber at Savi's Workshop. Also catch the incredible nighttime spectacular Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular drone and fireworks show.
experiences.location: Disney's Hollywood Studios, Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge, Walt Disney World Resort

experiences.name: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day
experiences.description: Spend a fun-filled day at Disney Springs, Disney's free-admission entertainment and shopping district. Enjoy live street performances, visit the LEGO Store, dine at world-class restaurants like The Boathouse or T-REX Cafe, catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater, and browse over 150 shops and boutiques. A budget-friendly Disney experience with no park ticket required.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience
experiences.description: Embark on the Kilimanjaro Safaris to see real African wildlife including lions, elephants, and giraffes roaming in natural habitats. Then journey to Pandora – The World of Avatar for the stunning Flight of Passage ride offering a breathtaking banshee flying experience. End the day with the Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular.
experiences.location: Disney's Animal Kingdom, Pandora – The World of Avatar, Walt Disney World Resort
